entries.text: [Announcer] Spirits of the tropics, heed our call!
[Announcer] Descend with your rhythms, for one and for all!
[Announcer] Goddess of fire, Pele by name!
[Announcer] Transform our pool to an ocean of flame!
[Announcer] And now from the waters, Citrikua emerge!
[Announcer] Oh great god of health, your secrets we urge!
[Clyde] Wowee! Phew, that's almost as much fun as New Year's Eve in the orange groves!
[Claude] My word! We did get mighty carried away, hah!
[Claude] I say, look out there across the water. It appears to be a bit of company!
[Clyde] Welcome you all!
[Claude] Permit us to introduce ourselves. My name is Claude and my loquacious cousin over here is...
[Clyde] I'll introduce myself if you don't mind. Hi there! I'm uhh, now let me see now. Huh, it's right on the tip of my beak.
[Claude] Clyde, birdbrain!
[Clyde] Oh yeah, I'm Clyde Birdbrain!
[Claude] Oh, I say. Perhaps you good people have never conversed with toucan birds before.
[Clyde] Well, neither did we. 'Til one day we discovered this magic sunshine pavilion.
[Claude] By Jove, yes. I remember just how it happened, uh, many many bird bars ago.
[Claude] There we were in an explorer's launch on a mysterious river in deepest Adventureland.
[Claude] Off in the distance comes a fierce roar of an African lion!
[Claude] As we round a bend in the river, a huge bull elephant bellows forth in protest of our intrusion!
[Claude] Suddenly, the treetops explode in a frenzy of outraged birds!
[Claude] Oh come come, you can jolly well do better than that!
[Clyde] I can jolly well do one at a time!
[Claude] Meanwhile, shifty-eyed crocodiles lurk by the waters edge.
[Clyde] Lurk... Lurk... Lurk...
[Claude] And the giant python slithers down from an overhanging limb.
[Clyde] Ahhhhh!
[Claude] What happened? What's wrong?
[Clyde] I can't stand snakes!
[Claude] Don't be ridiculous, I'm only relaying a story!
[Claude] Oh alright Clyde, enough is enough!
[Clyde] That wasn't me! I never even opened my beak!
[Claude] Huh?
[Cast Member] Excuse me guys, I hate to interrupt such an amazing story, but they're calling us for the show.
[Clyde] It's already showtime?
[Cast Member] Yes it's already show time, and Claude I believe it's your turn to make the announcements.
[Claude] I know. Ahem, ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, gather up all your cameras, purses, and other articles. And now turn to your left towards the tall door.
[Clyde] When the drums begin, they'll open magically to lead you right into the sunshine pavilion!
[Clyde] Is everybody ready?
[Cast Member] Come on, is everybody ready?
[Claude] Have a good show. A real tropical serenade!
[Cast Member] Aloha! And welcome to Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room!
[Cast Member] Please feel free to enjoy any food or beverages you brought with you.
[Cast Member] And if at anytime during our show you do need to exit, please feel free to warp out.
[Cast Member] Now, we have one last thing we need to do: we have to wake up our Master of Ceremonies, Jose!
[Cast Member] All together on the count of three:
[Cast Member] 1... 2... 3... Wake up Jose!
[José] Ahhh!
[José] Buenos dias, señorita. My siestas are getting chorter and chorter.
[José] Oh, look at all the people!
[José] And welcome to Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room.
[José] Hey, Michael, mi amigo!
[José] Pay attention—it's showtime.
[Michael] So it is.
[Michael] And what darling people I have sittin' under me.
[Michael] Pierre, you rascal, you!
[Michael] Let's put on the show.
[Pierre] Mon ami, I am always ready, as you say, to put on ze show.
[Pierre] Oh pardon, madame, that whistle was for my good friend Fritz.
[Fritz] Ach du Lieber! I almost fell out of mein upper perch.
[Fritz] Glad to see you all aboard—uh, ashore—or—
[Fritz] Verever you are!
[Fritz] Mein goodness, you're all shtaring at us.
[Fritz] We better shtart the show rolling!
[Michael] Wait! Wait!
[Michael] We forgot to wake up the glee club!
[José] Olé! Olé! It's showtime!

[Pierre] And our fine feathered friend is a jolly toucan,
[Pierre] and two can sound better than one toucan can.
[José] The bird of paradise is an elegant bird,
[José] It likes to be seen, and it loves to be heard.
[José] Most little birdies will fly away,

[Michael] Look, here come the girls!
[Fritz] Ach, ja! And the wunderbar bird mobile… Which has birds on it. And it goes round and round. Und dat's why they call it a “bird mobile.”
[Pierre] Madames and monsieur—introducing the lovely ladies of the ensembles. Just like the Follies Bergère with all the feathers.
